articles.summary: NEW YORK, Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Valley National Bancorp ( NASDAQ:VLY ), the holding company for Valley National Bank, announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 earnings before the market opens on Thursday, October 22, 2026. Valley’s CEO, Ira Robbins will host a conference call on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 8:30 AM (ET) to discuss Valley’s third quarter 2026 earnings. Interested parties should pre-register using this link: https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIc78e7eea64034897b9189c4e4fb690d9 to receive the dial-in number and a personal PIN, which are required to access the conference call. The teleconference will also be webcast live: https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/8hirkq3z and archived on Valley’s website through Monday, November 23, 2026. articles.summary: NEW YORK, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Valley National Bancorp ( NASDAQ: VLY ), the holding company for Valley National Bank, today reported net income for the third quarter 2026 of $206.3 million, or $0.36 per diluted common share, as compared to the second quarter 2026 net income of $170.9 million, or $0.29 per diluted common share, and net income of $163.4 million, or $0.28 per diluted common share, for the third quarter 2025. Excluding all non-core income and charges, our adjusted net income (a non-GAAP measure) was $206.4 million, or $0.36 per diluted common share, for the third quarter 2026, $172.8 million, or $0.30 per diluted common share, for the second quarter 2026, and $164.1 million, or $0.28 per diluted common share, for the third quarter 2025. See further details below, including a reconciliation of our non-GAAP adjusted net income, in the “Consolidated Financial Highlights” tables. articles.summary: NEW YORK, Oct. 20, 2026 - Valley National Bancorp ( NASDAQ:VLY ) (Valley), the holding company for Valley National Bank, announced today its regular preferred and common dividends. The declared quarterly dividends to shareholders of record on December 15, 2026 are as follows: A cash dividend of $0.517321 per share to be paid December 30, 2026 on Valleys Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock Series A; A cash dividend of $0.500132 per share to be paid December 30, 2026 on Valleys Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock Series B; A cash dividend of $0.515625 per share to be paid December 30, 2026 on Valleys Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock Series C; and A cash dividend of $0.11 per share will be paid January 4, 2027 on Valleys common stock.
